messages:
Sam: FYI — ZephyrTech procurement replied. They will not accept any invoice unless we attach their signed 'Purchase Authorization Letter' and include their internal ReqCode (REQ-XXXXX) in the invoice header. They marked our last invoice as "non-compliant" and returned it.
Priya: ugh. do we have that doc on file? who owns vendor onboarding for zephyr?
Sam: Not in our system. Customer pasted the email — small excerpt below.
Sam: "Per our policy, invoices must contain the Purchase Authorization Letter (scanned + signature) and our ReqCode placed in the invoice header field 'Customer ReqCode'. Without these we cannot process payment. Please resend or provide confirmation."
Priya: ok please forward the full mail thread to me and legal. Also confirm whether they require the signed SOW or just the one-page authorization.
Li: Holding any invoices for ZephyrTech until we get confirmation. I set billing-bot hold tag.
billing-bot: Invoice generation paused: customer=ZephyrTech, hold_reason=missing_authorization, ticket=INC-8321.
Sam: Customer attached a sample of how they want the header formatted. Posting sample so we don't guess:
Sam: ```
Invoice To: ZephyrTech
Customer ReqCode: REQ-45672
Purchase Authorization: attached_signed_letter.pdf (signed by procurement)
Tax ID: GB999999999
```
Priya: thanks. I'll request the signed letter from our account contact and ask for a short acceptance email if they won't reissue the PO. If they insist on PO number only, we'll need their procurement contact to confirm acceptance of current invoice with ReqCode.
Li: Note: their VAT ID in the sample (GB...) doesn't match the VAT we have on file. If they require corrected VAT on the invoice we may need finance to reissue. Tagging legal for potential contractual wording.
legal-bot: @Priya, @Sam — legal looped in. Please upload any customer-signed doc to the secure drive and set a retention flag. We may need to adjust invoicing terms.
Priya: created a private ticket to ZephyrTech procurement asking for either (a) signed Purchase Authorization Letter OR (b) explicit email confirming they will accept our invoice with ReqCode. CC'ing finance. Ticket: SUPPORT-7890.
Sam: Great. Action items: Sam to attach our draft with header sample to outreach, Priya to chase procurement, Li to keep invoice on hold. I'll update this thread when customer responds. :thumbsup:
Li: added note to billing system to not auto-send on next cycle.
Priya: ETA for reply from customer is EOD tomorrow per account contact. Will escalate if missing.
Sam: Closing loop for now — will post update when we have the signed doc or confirmation.
